[SWS_CRYPT_03304]
⌈
The FC Crypto shall support to bind additional
data non-malleable to the Ciphertext.
⌋

[SWS_CRYPT_03304] Key agreement - optional call parameters
⌈
The
interface ara::crypto::cryp::KeyAgreementPrivateCtx::AgreeKey shall
only process the optionally provided parameters ara::crypto::ReadOnlyMemRe-
gion salt and ara::crypto::ReadOnlyMemRegion ctxLabel, if required by the
configured ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId of this context.
If such parameters are
required, but not provided, an empty value shall be used.
⌋
